title: Meta Tags and SEO Basics
description: Understanding meta tags, their role in SEO, and best practices for optimizing web pages for search engines.

flashcards.question: What is the purpose of the `<meta charset>` tag?
flashcards.answer: It specifies the character encoding for the HTML document, commonly set to `UTF-8`.

flashcards.question: How does the `<meta name='viewport'>` tag help in responsive design?
flashcards.answer: It controls the viewport’s size and scale, ensuring the page is optimized for different devices.

flashcards.question: What meta tag is used to provide a description of the webpage?
Why are keywords in meta tags important?
flashcards.answer: They help search engines understand the content focus of the page, though their importance has decreased.

flashcards.question: What does the `<meta http-equiv='X-UA-Compatible'>` tag do?
flashcards.answer: It tells Internet Explorer which version to use for rendering the page.

flashcards.question: What is Open Graph protocol used for in meta tags?
flashcards.answer: To control how the webpage appears when shared on social media platforms.

flashcards.question: How can you specify the author of a webpage using meta tags?
What is the role of the `<title>` tag in SEO?
flashcards.answer: It defines the title shown in browser tabs and search engine results, influencing SEO.

flashcards.question: Can meta tags improve page loading speed?
flashcards.answer: Indirectly, by specifying viewport and charset, they can enhance rendering but do not directly affect speed.

flashcards.question: Why is it important to have unique meta descriptions for each page?
flashcards.answer: To avoid duplicate content issues and improve search engine rankings.
